title: Mind Control Clinic?
content: One dream I had, the kardashians were leading me around this clinic that was supposed to help improve my memory. It was super fancy, sterile, and eerie and I kept asking Kylie and Kim questions and they would just ignore me. Then I got to the exam room and the dr showed me this microchip on a silver medical tray and said “this will help you remember everything, and it’s only $2” and then I started feeling weird like “alright no way this boujie ass clinic about to give me the power to remember things better for $2” so I started trying to leave, and they wouldn’t let me.. eventually I ran out and they chased me and I got to the parking lot and ducked behind a car and the kardashians and the dr dude held me down as they implanted this chip in my head and said “don’t worry, you do this every night when you come here. You won’t remember anything” And then I woke up like wtf
